title: Gunflint Chert Microfossils
summary: The Gunflint Iron Formation at Schreiber Beach, Ontario, on Lake Superior's north shore, holds microfossils in chert dated at about 1.88 billion years. Stanley Tyler collected cherts there in 1953; the Barghoorn and Tyler paper describing the fossils appeared in 1965.

uncertainty.note: Age of the formation, given as 1.88 Ga by Nature Communications (2017); the Wisconsin newsletter rounds it to 2 billion years. Tyler's visit was in 1953 and the Barghoorn-Tyler paper appeared in 1965.

where.modern_name: Schreiber Beach area near Schreiber, Ontario, Canada (pin is the town of Schreiber, a proxy for the outcrop)

paleo.not_applicable: paleo reconstruction service returned errors; not computed

importance.justification: Well-known Precambrian microfossil locality whose fossils were described in a 1965 Science paper.
